agile.label: Agile Transformation
agile._comment: A maturity model: answers 'where are you now' and routes to a package.

stages.name: Foundational
stages.diagnostic_lens: Chaotic → tool sprawl, unclear workflows, burnout signals.
stages.focus: Restore clarity, reduce cognitive load, establish hygiene.
stages.outcomes: Reduced clutter, clear workflows, initial alignment.
stages.ai_augmentation: Automated Jira board cleanup, duplicate detection, backlog hygiene assistant.

stages.name: Emerging
stages.diagnostic_lens: Structured → boards cleaned, cadence exists, but ceremonies feel stale.
stages.outcomes: Improved trust, reduced burnout, meaningful rituals.
stages.deliverables: Morale metrics dashboard, role clarifications, team health interventions.
stages.ai_augmentation: Retro documentation, sprint flow insights, facilitation prompts.

stages.name: Enabled
stages.diagnostic_lens: Modular → frameworks adopted, backlog hygiene maintained, morale engagement rising.
stages.focus: Pilot modular Agile practices with one team, refine cadence, prepare for scale.
stages.outcomes: Autonomous teams, faster iteration, clear accountability.
stages.ai_augmentation: Backlog prioritization rubric, automated work item creation, sprint health dashboards.

stages.name: Scaling
stages.diagnostic_lens: Sustainable (early) → teams self-manage hygiene, cross-team visibility emerging.
stages.focus: Replicate modular practices across teams, align governance.
stages.outcomes: Scalable Agile practices, consistent delivery, cross-team transparency.
stages.deliverables: Scaled rollout plan, cross-team coaching, governance map.
stages.ai_augmentation: Cross-team dashboards, compliance reporting, predictive bottleneck detection.

stages.name: Optimizing
stages.diagnostic_lens: Sustainable (advanced) → predictive dashboards, audit-ready compliance, continuous improvement culture.
stages.focus: Strategic agility, continuous improvement, business alignment.
stages.outcomes: Sustained momentum, strategic alignment, high morale.
stages.deliverables: Advanced dashboards, strategic workshops, compliance frameworks.
stages.ai_augmentation: Predictive analytics, strategic scenario modeling, continuous improvement dashboards.
